method.dialogue_comparison: case/punctuation normalization, expanding let's to let us
method.limitations: Tiny ASR can misrecognize isolated numbers. Numeric/text matches check recognized meaning, not correct articulation. Context matches never clear isolated pronunciation warnings. Independent pronunciation review is required; automated checks do not replace final listening.

acceptance.reason: An ASR match alone is not pronunciation approval. Use the separate hash-bound pronunciation acceptance gate.
